from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"suite/fuzz/onefile.c","function":"main","line":11,"var":"argv[1]","code":"fopen(argv[1], \"rb\")","note":"The attacker controls the path to the raw input file that will be loaded into memory."},
  {"step":2,"file":"suite/fuzz/onefile.c","function":"main","line":23,"var":"Size","code":"Size = ftell(fp);","note":"The file length is measured and used to allocate and read the entire candidate input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"suite/fuzz/onefile.c","function":"main","line":29,"var":"Data","code":"Data = malloc(Size);","note":"The raw bytes are copied into a heap buffer so the fuzzer entrypoint receives attacker-controlled data."},
  {"step":4,"file":"suite/fuzz/onefile.c","function":"main","line":35,"var":"Data","code":"fread(Data, Size, 1, fp)","note":"The exact file contents become the input bytes passed to LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput."},
  {"step":5,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":191,"var":"Data[0]","code":"int i = (int)Data[0] % platforms_len;","note":"The first byte selects the architecture/mode pair, steering execution into a specific disassembler backend."},
  {"step":6,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":193,"var":"handle","code":"cs_open(platforms[i].arch, platforms[i].mode, &handle);","note":"Capstone initializes the chosen backend and prepares to decode the remaining attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":198,"var":"count","code":"count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);","note":"The backend disassembles the input stream and returns an array of decoded instructions."},
  {"step":8,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":203,"var":"j","code":"for (j = 0; j < count; j++)","note":"Each decoded instruction is printed, and the loop body dereferences per-instruction detail fields."},
  {"step":9,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":208,"var":"detail","code":"detail = i->detail;","note":"The code assumes every decoded instruction has a populated detail object and immediately reads its counters."},
  {"step":10,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":210,"var":"detail->regs_read_count","code":"if (detail->regs_read_count > 0)","note":"This dereference is the memory-safety sink: if the backend left detail uninitialized or invalid for a crafted instruction, the read triggers an invalid access."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
PY
